Thanks for the remittance and sweep file — received. A few quick asks so we can close July: 

1) VAT handling: our default is to post VAT-withheld as a pass-through (separate tax clearing GL) so AR can match gross invoice amounts against payments. That helps preserve invoice-level reporting. Can you confirm the numeric VAT amount you withheld for rows 342/347 and the corresponding invoice numbers? I see invoice refs but want to be explicit.

2) Virtual account mapping: in the CSV column "VA_ID" you have three IDs; please confirm which invoices were assigned to each VA. We prefer the VA mapping applied at invoice-level rather than at batch-level aggregation.

3) Bank trace: thanks for the trace number — we'll use that for treasury reconciliation. If possible, could you also provide the recipient reference field content from your bank (some of our postings show an abbreviated ref and we want the full string).

I've looped in Vanessa (Collections lead) and Lauren (Revenue Ops) to propose the AR apply flow once we have the specifics. If it's easier, Vanessa — can you propose the journal entries/GL mapping to accept the sweep as-is and leave the VAT as pass-through?

Best,
